The ladder blocks in the two skills are byte-identical (diff prints nothing). `claude plugin install --help` confirms that -s/--scope exists, so the install hint uses only a real flag. `lisa doctor` registers the check as 'Session manager Telegram isolation?' deviations: Step 9 runs `lisa doctor` and falls back to `npx @codyswann/lisa doctor`, because a multi-repo host root often has no local lisa bin. The bin name is 'lisa' per package.json.
Step 4's not-installed branch suggests `claude plugin install telegram@claude-plugins-official -s user`. It then re-checks, so the user-scope-enabled remedy fires if installing enabled it.
